items.title: Hunter Henry ends limbo, signing a 2-year extension with Patriots through 2027
items.summary: Tight end Hunter Henry confirmed Monday that he signed a two-year extension to remain in New England through the 2027 season.  ESPN and the NFL Network reported that the extended pact has a base value of $16 million with incentives that could push it up to $20 million.  It ends a period of limbo for Henry, who was about to enter the final season of the previous three-year extension he signed in 2024.
